messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Deployement problem - Disconnected from the server.
parts:
Have you checked the logs for your application using the rsconnect::showLogs() function?

On Mon, Feb 15, 2016 at 1:27 PM, Loïc Brach <loic....@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I have use ShinyApps for the first time yesterday and have successfully create my application, which run in a local server or directly in RStudio. 

However when I want to deploy the application in my www.shinyapps.io server, I use the command : "shinyapps::deployApp('C:/Users/Loïc/Documents/JE/Assurance Vie Viager/Application_Viager_Simple')" but I always get the messages "Disconnected from the server." in the web page and in R console the error : 
"Warning message:
Error detecting locale: Error in read.table(file = file, header = header, sep = sep, quote = quote, : incomplete final line found by readTableHeader on 'raw'
 (Using default: en_US)"

Does everyone know why this is happening and how to fix this problem ?

Thanks in advance.

Loïc
